notes: CPU: vDSP vectorized, one chunk per core. GPU: shared storage buffers, full DRAM traffic. Tensor: MTL4 encoder native tensor copy.
CPU timed in three 3s windows (median per window reported); pre-flight aborts if the SoC is busy so background daemons cannot contaminate a measurement.

GPU timed via Metal GPU timestamps (gpuEndTime-gpuStartTime, 8 dispatches/command buffer) to exclude CPU commit/wait overhead; a self-calibrating mixed CPU+GPU primer runs until measured GPU-copy bandwidth recovers to >=340 GB/s sustained over two consecutive windows (20-120s) so deep-idle processes converge to the same power state.
